name: CryptoPayment Gateway
author: Soshi Inagawa

sections.description: CryptoPay Gateway was built with the core values of cryptocurrency in mind, with regards to anonymity and security. The plugin seamlessly enables your woocommerce store to accept Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Litecoin, Dogecoin, and more, right away by simply adding your wallet addresses.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/cryptopayment-gateway directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the ‘Settings’ link in the plugin list to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I configure my wallet addresses?

Go to the plugin settings page and enter your wallet addresses for the supported cryptocurrencies.

Which cryptocurrencies are supported?

The plugin currently supports Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Litecoin, Dogecoin, and more.
